fixture.server_name_note: A unique workspace-local name prevented an existing user-global server with the name truenorth from shadowing the certification server. The prompt and captured protocol traffic used only truenorth407.

procedure: Install truenorth-mcp@1.0.2 and @truenorth-mcp/darwin-arm64@1.0.2 in a disposable package root with install scripts disabled.
Run the released wrapper init command with the generic profile in a disposable workspace.
Write the workspace-local .kiro/settings/mcp.json configuration shown above. Use a unique server name if the user already has a global server with the same name.
Launch Kiro with isolated --user-data-dir and --extensions-dir paths and open only the disposable workspace.
Trust the disposable workspace, open the Kiro panel, and confirm that the workspace-local server reports Connected (19 tools).
In Agent Focus, select Add context, MCP, and the workspace-local state resource. Ask Kiro to call get_skill and truenorth_record_task on the workspace-local server.
Quit Kiro with Command-Q. Check the fixture release plan, Kiro extension-host logs, and server stderr for the mutation and clean shutdown evidence.

client_evidence.source: sanitized stdio protocol proxy, Kiro MCP and extension-host logs, Kiro UI, disposable release plan, and server stderr

install.detail: Released truenorth-mcp 1.0.2 and its darwin-arm64 platform package ran from a disposable install root.

lifecycle_negotiation.detail: Kiro used modern server/discover with MCP 2026-07-28. The complete response included ttlMs 0 and private cache scope.

tools_list.detail: Kiro requested tools/list and displayed the workspace-local server as Connected (19 tools).

resources_list.detail: Kiro requested resources/list and displayed all five resources in its MCP context picker. The complete response included ttlMs 0 and private cache scope.

resource_read.detail: Kiro requested truenorth://state through its MCP context picker and received a complete private response with ttlMs 0.

read_tool_operation.detail: Kiro called get_skill for spike-prototype at the lean tier and rendered the returned skill.

task_mutation.detail: Kiro called truenorth_record_task exactly once. Only the disposable release plan received the requested task.

clean_shutdown.detail: Command-Q closed Kiro. Its extension hosts exited with code 0, the server logged a closed input stream, and the traced server process no longer existed.

workspace_isolation.detail: The run used a disposable workspace and workspace-local MCP configuration. User-global Kiro configuration and the real project workspace were not mutated.
